item.title: Open Source Daily — Sunday, October 11, 2026
item.description: Ollama CVE-2026-103663 /api/pull path traversal + v0.40.2 model-upgrade backups (MLX default); Rapid-MLX 0.16.0 TensorFold (Bonsai 2 27B, Gemma 4 26B, DeepSeek V4 Flash) + 64GB fit; llama.cpp b11521 llama-server port 9931; Python 3.15.0; SQLite 3.54.0; REA reverse-engineering MCP (morluto/rea). Tool: Talorys (Cloudflare self-hosted agent). Quick: Claude Code CVE-2026-103435; Littleguys menu bar; KDE Plasma 6.8 next week; Ubuntu 26.10 RISC-V desktop. Watch: Linux 7.3-rc7.
